workflow: Open EVA Air official online booking page
Set trip type, airports, dates, party and cabin
Search fares and collect up to five useful exact-date options
Capture total, currency, fare family, baggage and change/refund summaries when visible
Stop before traveler identity, card entry, OTP/3DS or final purchase
special_rules: Official booking page states maximum 9 occupied tickets per transaction, excluding infant tickets.
At least one traveler must be age 16 or older; infant/child accompaniment rules shown by official UI must be obeyed.
Do not use promotional fare cards as final quotes; official page itself advises checking the total after flight selection.
known_blockers: CAPTCHA can appear in some booking flows
Member/credit-card promotion flows alter the form
Special child/infant cases require human handling
revalidate: Re-search the exact itinerary and fare family immediately before human checkout.
safety: Stop at login, OTP, 3DS, CAPTCHA, anti-bot or identity verification.
failure_policy: Retry one semantic interaction after an ordinary stale ref.
Never guess fare, airport, date or restrictions.
